recentItems.title: Alien Breed - Official 35th Anniversary Collection Announcement Trailer
recentItems.description: Get a look at the 35th Anniversary Collection Announcement Trailer for Alien Breed, a collection of classic retro action shooters developed by Antstream. Players can soon gain access to six classic installments of the Alien Breed franchise with modern controls, co-op multiplayer, new Rush and Horde modes, and more. The Alien Breed 35th Anniversary Collection is launching in September 2026 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam, GoG, and Epic Games Store).

recentItems.title: Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Deathmaster - Official Gameplay Trailer
recentItems.description: Check out the latest Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Deathmaster trailer to see gameplay from the upcoming 2D action platformer game. In Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Deathmaster, play a sneaky and brutal Skaven Assassin. Skulk through unstable under-empire realms, master the deadly arts of Clan Eshin, set traps, execute with precision, gather Warpstones and unlock devastating new abilities. Watch Vihneek rise through treachery and blood. Escape. Kill. Ascend. Become a Deathmaster. Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Deathmaster will be available on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027.

recentItems.title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 - Official Release Date Trailer
recentItems.description: Here's a look at the Release Date Trailer for Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2, a retro arcade first-person shooter developed by Auroch Digital. Players can get a new look at the intense action as Ultramarine Malum Caedo and Sister of Battle Nyra Veyrath take on Vashtorr the Arkifane, a formidable demigod who's ready to lay waste to the enemy. Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 is launching on October 14 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam), with a release coming soon to Nintendo Switch 2.

recentItems.title: Rise of the Merchants - Official Gameplay Reveal
recentItems.description: Check out the Gameplay Reveal for Rise of the Merchants, an upcoming economic and political strategy game developed by Black Duke Games. Players will take on the challenges of medieval Europe to meet the demands of the people, navigate political inquiries with care, and establish a bustling settlement through key decisions. Rise of the Merchants is coming soon to PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: Neo Berlin 2087 - Official Pre-Alpha Gameplay Demo | gamescom 2026
recentItems.description:
Take a look at the Pre-Alpha Gameplay Demo for Neo Berlin 2087, an upcoming sci-fi action RPG developed by Elysium Game Studio. Players will traverse a cyberpunk future as Nolan, a detective out to bring a dark conspiracy to light. Switch between first-person and third-person combat perspectives, reconstruct memories to search for clues, and find the Police Chief's daughter at all costs. Enjoy over 16 minutes of gameplay showcasing dialogue choices, action-packed combat, and more. Neo Berlin 2087 is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
